UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private player game state, upgrades, cat customization, daily streak, quests, badges, and profile customization.

selectedCatName.description: Custom name given to the player's cat.

unlockedBackgrounds.description: List of unlocked sanctuary room background IDs.

upgradeLevels.description: Map of shop upgrade ID to owned level.

lastDailyClaimEpochDay.description: UTC epoch day of the last claimed daily reward.

unlockedBadgeIds.description: List of unlocked achievement badge IDs.

equippedBadgeId.description: Equipped badge ID shown on leaderboard.

eventPurrsEarned.description: Purrs earned during periodic limited-time events.

weatherCheckedCount.description: Number of live weather syncs completed.

statsPublic.description: Whether detailed lifetime stats are visible when others tap the player's leaderboard profile.

bio.description: Short custom profile bio shown on the player's leaderboard card.

avatarBase64.description: Compressed custom profile picture JPEG encoded as Base64.

bannerBase64.description: Compressed custom profile banner JPEG encoded as Base64.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of profile creation (client writes FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last save (client writes FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Public non-PII global leaderboard showcase entry and interactive profile card.

totalPurrsEarned.description: Total lifetime purrs used for global ranking.

statsPublic.description: Whether public stats are visible in profile popup.

avatarBase64.description: Compressed custom profile picture JPEG encoded as Base64.

bannerBase64.description: Compressed custom profile banner JPEG encoded as Base64.

publicRebirths.description: Rebirth count shared if statsPublic is true.

publicAscensions.description: Gato Ascension count shared if statsPublic is true.

publicDailyStreak.description: Current daily streak shared if statsPublic is true.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last leaderboard sync.

ModerationRecord.title: ModerationRecord
ModerationRecord.description: Admin-managed player moderation state supporting warnings, timeouts, and bans.

reason.description: Warning, timeout, or ban message shown to the player.

timeoutUntilMillis.description: UTC epoch millis when a timeout expires.

warningCount.description: Total warnings issued to this account.

updatedByEmail.description: Verified admin email that issued the moderation action.

GlobalAnnouncement.title: GlobalAnnouncement
GlobalAnnouncement.description: Global sanctuary broadcast message authored exclusively by the verified admin.

title.description: Short headline shown on broadcast banner.

severity.description: Visual style category for the announcement.

LimitedItemCounter.title: LimitedItemCounter
LimitedItemCounter.description: Global Exist Counter tracking how many limited-time items exist across caretakers.

itemId.description: Prefixed limited-time item ID (pat_*, acc_*, thm_*, or bg_*).

existCount.description: Total number of this limited-time item unlocked worldwide.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest unlock increment.

/users/{userId}.description: Private per-user game state and profile.

/leaderboard/{userId}.description: Public non-PII global leaderboard entries with clickable profile cards.

/moderation/{userId}.description: Per-user moderation state written by the admin and readable only by the target owner or admin.

/global_messages/{messageId}.description: Global broadcast messages sent by the admin and displayed to signed-in players.

/limited_item_stats/{itemId}.description: Global Exist Counters incremented atomically whenever a limited-time item is unlocked.
